sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS All shares of common stock offered by this prospectus are being registered for the account of the Selling Stockholders named in this prospectus and we will not receive any proceeds from the sale of these shares. However, upon the cash exercise of the Warrants, we will receive the exercise price of such Warrants, for an aggregate of approximately $11.76 million. We cannot predict when and in what amounts or if the Warrants will be exercised by payments of cash and it is possible that the Warrants may expire and never be exercised, in which case we would not receive any cash proceeds. We intend to use those proceeds, if any, to advance and execute plans for future research and development activities, for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
